verdict.rationale: Scheduled sending and undo-send are fair questions for an email API provider like AgentMail, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents neither a send-at/scheduled-send parameter nor an undo grace window. Draft review before sending is a different feature (human approval), not delayed or reversible sending, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule an email to send later and undo a send within a grace window
